title: Can The Human Body Handle Rotating Artificial Gravity?
summary: Scott Manley surveys the research on whether people can adapt to rotating artificial gravity, from early Soviet centrifuge tests to modern studies. He concludes it is an engineering problem and discusses Coriolis effects and station radius.
why: Linked as the clear explainer on rotational gravity and its Coriolis oddities.

quote.text: Scott Manley has a great video on artificial gravity in space
